$comment: Spec-to-ship pipeline. Stages can be switched off individually; the routing engine in scripts/wf.mjs skips a disabled stage without changing how the rest behave.

convergence.$comment: Retry is the exception. Only a finding that is addressed to code, carries a witness, and is uncontested is ever retried.

breakers.$comment: Fuses, not checks. They understand nothing about the code and therefore cannot be wrong about it.

isolation.$comment: Worktrees isolate files and nothing else. Ports, both databases, the mail sink and .local-storage are shared, so runs are serialised until those are per-run too.
